title: Triage Before Fine-Tuning: Feasibility-Gated Selection and Monitored Adaptation of Embodied Foundation Models for a Fixed Physical Platform
abstract: arXiv:2611.33772v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Embodied foundation models are increasingly deployed by selection: a practitioner picks a public checkpoint by benchmark rank and fine-tunes it on local data. The platform is fixed before the model is chosen, with little or no local data. We ask what such a checkpoint loses on a fixed platform and which part of the loss local data can buy back. We split the gap by what can repair it. A sensing gap, information the sensors do not capture, cannot be closed with their data; a latency gap, output arriving after the control loop needs it, belongs to the loop, not the weights; only a distribution gap is fine-tuning's to repair. TRIAGE turns this into feasibility-gated selection and monitored adaptation in five stages: gates on the sensor contract and on end-to-end latency that no score can override, probes on ten minutes of local logs, a ranking by target-relevant score among the candidates that pass, and fine-tuning that is monitored and ch

translated_title: 微调之前的分诊：面向固定物理平台的具身基础模型的可行性门控选择与受监控适配
translated_abstract: 具身基础模型越来越多地通过“选择”来部署：实践者根据基准排名挑选一个公开的模型检查点，然后在本地数据上对其进行微调。物理平台在模型选择之前就已固定，本地数据很少甚至没有。我们探究这样的检查点在固定平台上究竟损失了什么，以及本地数据能够买回其中哪一部分损失。我们按照“什么能够修复差距”来对差距进行分类：感知差距（传感器未捕捉到的信息）无法靠数据来弥补；延迟差距（输出到达时间晚于控制回路所需）属于控制回路而非模型权重的问题；只有分布差距才是微调能够修复的。TRIAGE 将这一思路转化为五阶段的可行性门控选择与受监控适配：先在传感器契约和端到端延迟上设置任何分数都无法逾越的门控，再用十分钟本地日志进行探测，在通过门控的候选模型中按目标相关分数排序，最后执行受监控的微调……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 TRIAGE 框架，在微调之前先按“差距能否被修复”将其分为感知差距、延迟差距和分布差距三类，并通过传感器与延迟可行性门控、十分钟本地日志探测和受监控微调，在固定物理平台上避免用微调去修复本不可修复的损失。
en_tdlr: TRIAGE introduces feasibility-gated selection and monitored adaptation of embodied foundation models: it classifies performance gaps as sensing, latency, or distribution gaps—only the latter being repairable by fine-tuning—and gates candidates on sensor contract and end-to-end latency before probing, ranking, and monitored fine-tuning on a fixed physical platform.
